messages.content: I'm planning a small web app for tracking my reading. Should I use SQLite or Postgres?
For a single-user app, SQLite is simpler: no server, one file, easy backups. Postgres makes sense once you need concurrent writers or hosting.
OK, SQLite then. What about the frontend, React or plain HTML templates?
If the pages are mostly forms and lists, server-rendered templates keep it simple. React pays off when there is a lot of client-side interaction.
Templates it is. One more thing: how should I back up the database?
Copy the file while no writes are happening, or use the SQLite online backup API. A nightly cron job that copies it to cloud storage is enough.
Decision: SQLite, templates, nightly backup to S3. Can you draft the schema next?
Sure. Tables: books(id, title, author, status), sessions(id, book_id, date, pages). I'll add indexes on book_id and date.
